blocks.label: Jump Game VI (LC1696): deque-fed DP
blocks.py:
import heapq
dp = [0]*n
dq = deque()                             # indices with dp DECREASING
for i in range(n):
    while dq and dq[0] < i - k: dq.popleft()      # expire out-of-range
    dp[i] = (dp[dq[0]] if dq else 0) + a[i]
    while dq and dp[dq[-1]] <= dp[i]: dq.pop()
    dq.append(i)
answer = dp[n-1]

chain.a: Dual monotonic deques (max-deque + min-deque); shrink while max−min>limit. Two structures one walk.
